name: Durable Recovery Anchor (C-1)
goal: Stop tombstoneTerminalAssignment from deleting a private branch on a raw-SHA recovery_ref; upgrade a legacy raw-SHA row to refs/ironclaude/recovery/<guid> before branch deletion.

tasks.name: Durable-anchor gate + reader-side upgrade (RED then GREEN)
tasks.description: Add private refIsDurableRef (git show-ref --verify actual-ref test) and ensureDurableRecoveryAnchor (no-op for ref-name recovery_ref; mint refs/ironclaude/recovery/<guid> + DB-upgrade for a legacy raw SHA; throw for unanchorable) to WorkspaceService, and call ensureDurableRecoveryAnchor in tombstoneTerminalAssignment's abandoned path before removeWorktree/deleteTemporaryBranch. TDD: write four tests first (legacy raw-SHA absent + present upgrade; ref-name no-op regression using a vi.spyOn(database,'prepare') detector that asserts no recovery_ref UPDATE runs; unanchorable-preserve), verify RED, implement, verify GREEN.

steps.description: Add vi to the vitest import at line 1 of workspace-service.test.ts (currently `{ afterEach, describe, expect, it }` -> `{ afterEach, describe, expect, it, vi }`). Then append four tests to the existing describe block, mirroring the harness near lines 1109-1154 (repository(), initDb, new WorkspaceService, ensureSessionWorktree, git(), writeFileSync, existsSync, join). Construct a legacy raw-SHA row by rescue-abandoning then deleting the minted recovery ref and overwriting recovery_ref with the bare SHA. Tests: (a) legacy raw-SHA absent worktree -> upgrade + branch-safe; (b) legacy raw-SHA present worktree -> upgrade + branch-safe; (c) ref-name recovery_ref -> no re-mint, proven by vi.spyOn(database,'prepare') asserting zero UPDATE statements touching recovery_ref during cleanup (updated_at cannot detect this: transitionAssignment always rewrites updated_at); (d) raw-SHA object absent -> throws /preserving it/, row+branch preserved.
steps.expected: vi added to the import; four new tests added to workspace-service.test.ts

steps.description: Run only the recovery_ref-tagged tests to confirm RED.
steps.expected: the two legacy raw-SHA upgrade tests FAIL: current code passes the abandoned proof on the bare SHA, deletes the branch, and mints no refs/ironclaude/recovery/<guid>, so git rev-parse/cat-file on that ref errors.

steps.description: Add refIsDurableRef and ensureDurableRecoveryAnchor as private methods immediately after refResolves (ending :651). refIsDurableRef runs runGit(root,['show-ref','--verify','--quiet',ref]) in try/catch. ensureDurableRecoveryAnchor: throw if !recovery_ref; return current if refIsDurableRef(current); throw if !refResolves(current); else mint refs/ironclaude/recovery/<guid> via runGit update-ref at current, UPDATE assignments SET recovery_ref=?, updated_at=datetime('now') WHERE workspace_guid=?, return the ref name. Then in tombstoneTerminalAssignment insert, after the abandoned/integrated proof if/else block and before `if (present) removeWorktree(...)`: `if (assignment.lifecycle_status === 'abandoned') { this.ensureDurableRecoveryAnchor(repository, assignment); }`.
steps.expected: workspace-service.ts has both helpers and the call site

steps.description: Build commander pytest batch lists. The absolute ls glob already yields absolute paths, so NO prefix is prepended. Portable split -l; rm -f clears stale batch files; wc -l is in-band proof.
steps.command: rm -f /tmp/dra_tests.txt /tmp/dra_batch_* && ls /Users/roberthyatt/Code/ironclaude/commander/tests/test_*.py | sort > /tmp/dra_tests.txt && total=$(wc -l < /tmp/dra_tests.txt) && per=$(( (total + 3) / 4 )) && split -l "$per" /tmp/dra_tests.txt /tmp/dra_batch_ && wc -l /tmp/dra_tests.txt /tmp/dra_batch_*
steps.expected: 4 batch files _aa.._ad, line counts summing to the /tmp/dra_tests.txt total (if only 3 files appear, run only those).

steps.description: Run commander pytest batches (repeat for _aa,_ab,_ac,_ad as separate Bash calls), excluding destructive tests. The test -s guard aborts rather than silently running the full suite; batch files hold absolute paths so no prefix is added.
steps.command: test -s /tmp/dra_batch_aa || { echo "FATAL: /tmp/dra_batch_aa missing/empty — refusing to run pytest without file args"; exit 1; } && cd /Users/roberthyatt/Code/ironclaude/commander && PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -m "not destructive" $(tr '\n' ' ' < /tmp/dra_batch_aa)
steps.expected: across the batches: 2867 passed, 2 deselected, 0 failed
